justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/RandomAccessFileMode.java` and its references. Fan-in is present but modest: `rg` found 5 main-source users (`IORandomAccessFile.java`, `AbstractOrigin.java`, `PathUtils.java`, `MagicNumberFileFilter.java`, and the class itself) and 9 test files. Fan-out is limited: the enum imports only 2 project-local collaborators (`IOConsumer`, `IOFunction` are functional helpers; the only project-local class it directly uses is `IORandomAccessFile`) and otherwise mostly JDK types, so it does not behave like a dependency hub.
